description:
# 🇫🇷 FrenchEconomy

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-PowerNukkitX-green)
![Language](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-Java-orange)

**FrenchEconomy** is a complete economy plugin developed for **PowerNukkitX**, allowing you to manage a virtual economy on your Minecraft Bedrock server.

The plugin provides a wallet system, player-to-player money transfers, leaderboards, and an easy-to-use economy management system.

---

# ✨ Features

## 💰 Money Management

* Automatic player wallet creation
* Persistent data storage
* Player cache system for better performance (Native + online cache)
* Protection against negative balances
* Fully configurable
* Simple API for developers

---

# 👤 Player Commands

| Command                  | Description                  |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `/mymoney`               | View your current balance    |
| `/pay <player> <amount>` | Send money to another player |
| `/top-money`             | View the richest players     |

---

# 🔧 Admin Commands

| Command                        | Description            |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| `/give-money <player> <amount>` | Give money to a player |
| `/reduce-money <player> <amount>` | Reduce money to a player |
| `/set-money <player> <amount>` | Set money to a player |

---

# 🔑 Permissions

| Permission                  | Description      |
| --------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `economy.command.givemoney` | Use `/givemoney` |
| `economy.command.reducemoney` | Use `/givemoney` |
| `economy.command.setmoney` | Use `/givemoney` |

---

# ⚙️ Configuration

FrenchEconomy provides a fully configurable message system.

Example:

```yaml
default-money: 500
topmoney.limit: 10

mymoney.description: §a- §fSee your money
givemoney.description: §a- §fGive money to a player
setmoney.description: §a- §fSet money to a player
reducemoney.description: §a- §fReduce money to a player
topmoney.description: §a- §fView top money
pay.description: §a- §fPay player

givemoney.usage: '§cUsage: /givemoney <player> <amount>'
setmoney.usage: '§cUsage: /set-money <player> <amount>'
reducemoney.usage: '§cUsage: /reduce-money <player> <amount>'
pay.usage: '§cUsage: /pay <player> <amount>'

mymoney.message: §aYou have §e{money}$

givemoney.message.sender: §aYou gave §e{money}$ §ato §b{player}
givemoney.message.receiver: §aYou received §e{money}$ §afrom §b{sender}
setmoney.message.sender: §aYou set §e{money}$ §ato §b{player}
setmoney.message.receiver: §aYour money was set to §e{money}$ §afrom §b{sender}
pay.sender: §aYou sent §e{money}$ §ato §b{player}
pay.receiver: §aYou received §e{money}$ §afrom §b{player}
pay.self: §cYou cannot pay yourself.
reducemoney.message.sender: §aYou reduce §e{money}$ §ato §b{player}
reducemoney.message.receiver: §aYour money was reduced to §e{money}$ §afrom §b{sender}

topmoney.header: §e§lTop Money
topmoney.format: '§e#{rank} §f{player}§7: §e{money}$'
topmoney.empty: §cNo player found.

error.only.ingame: §c- §fOnly player command.
error.get.wallet: §c- §fAn error occured while getting your wallet.
error.player.not.found: §c- §fPlayer not found.
error.invalid.amount: §c- §fInvalid amount.
error.not.enough.money: §cYou don't have enough money.
error.input.must.positive: §c- §fInput must be positive.
```
---

# 💾 Data Storage

FrenchEconomy uses a wallet-based system.

Each player has a wallet containing their economy data: (for devs: you can add wallets)

```java
Wallet {
    money
}
```

The system includes:

* Player cache
* Automatic saving
* YAML storage
* Easy API access for other plugins

---

# 📦 Installation

1. Download the latest `.jar` file
2. Put it inside your server plugins folder:

```text
plugins/
```

3. Restart your PowerNukkitX server
